name: OmniGS
definition: A novel omnidirectional Gaussian splatting system that takes calibrated monocular 360-degree images and sparse SfM point clouds as input to recover 3D Gaussians for fast radiance field reconstruction and real-time omnidirectional novel view synthesis.
summary: OmniGS enables real-time omnidirectional novel view synthesis by directly splatting 3D Gaussians onto equirectangular screen space, avoiding the tangent-plane approximations used by other methods.
